description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) for different dense passage retrieval (DPR) methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)." and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and has a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. A black solid line, representing "DPR w/o query," begins at approximately 34.7 at x=1 and ends at approximately 34.7 at x=10, remaining relatively constant across the x-axis. A red solid line with circular markers, representing "DPR w/ corpus expansion," begins at approximately 35.5 at x=1 and ends at approximately 35.8 at x=10, showing a general increasing trend. A green solid line with triangular markers, representing "DPR w/ document expansion," begins at approximately 34.9 at x=1, reaches a peak of approximately 35.1 at x=5, and ends at approximately 34.8 at x=10. A blue solid line with star-shaped markers, representing "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion," begins at approximately 34.6 at x=1, declines to approximately 34.4 at x=10, with a minimum value of approximately 34.3 at x=8.
